name: Central Narcotics Bureau

scam_info.sample: an email was sent from email address "info.centralnarcoticsbureau@gmail.com" claiming that the recipient of the email had an inheritance fund
scam_info.notes: Issued 12 Jun 2013. Advance-fee/inheritance scam using a CNB-branded Gmail address; demands money be sent to Nigeria.

scam_info.sample: CNB officers will only send emails from addresses ending with “@cnb.gov.sg”.
scam_info.notes: Issued 3 Feb 2022. Fake photo-contest emails impersonating CNB and Singapore Polytechnic. Scam addresses are not published; the page lists official channels instead (allowlist).

scam_info.sample: some person/s had been impersonating a CNB officer and had messaged others via WhatsApp messages, informing them that they ‘ have cases with CNB ’ and attempting to request for money.
rss.xml: 200 items, 18 Feb 2023 to 23 Nov 2026; none mention scams
scam_info.notes: RSS declared via rel=alternate. Sitemap https://www.cnb.gov.sg/sitemap.xml (870 URLs, 770 news). Only 3 scam/impersonation items, all 2013-2022 and older than the RSS window. JSON-LD dates are a bulk 2026-07-30 re-save, so use the in-text date.

notes: Low-volume impersonation publisher. One concrete IOC: info.centralnarcoticsbureau@gmail.com (2013). Named in the MHA 12 Aug 2026 fake-websites advisory.
